verdict.rationale: LangGraph ships official Python (and JS) SDKs installable via pip/npm, with extensive first-party API documentation (graph API, persistence, streaming, interrupts) and a CLI (langgraph dev/deploy) for building against it, corroborated by community developers actually building nodes/tools directly against the SDK. Missing for 10: explicit JS/TS SDK parity documentation and independent benchmarking of SDK API stability/versioning beyond community complaints about breaking changes.
